summary: Architecture and design evidence for Temporal Confirmation / Sliding Re-Score: a repeated Paraphrase/Semantic detection for the same reference, within the existing dedup window and while the original suggestion is still Pending, now bumps that suggestion's confidence and confirmation count instead of being silently discarded as pure noise.
audit: process_transcript_segment (core/service) and handle_final_transcript (pipeline.rs) were traced end to end: every detection is scored exactly once, from a single transcript segment, with no mechanism that ever revisits that score. The existing SUGGESTION_DEDUP_WINDOW_SECONDS (60s) dedup check already detects a same-category repeat but only ever suppresses it - the repeat itself was never used as evidence.
latentBugFound: DetectionCategory had only Explicit and Paraphrase variants - ReferenceKind::Semantic fell into the Explicit bucket by omission (pipeline.rs's category match had no Semantic arm). has_recent_detection_for_reference's Explicit SQL branch only checks detection_type IN ('DIRECT_REFERENCE','VERSE_REFERENCE','SEQUENTIAL_REFERENCE') - never 'SEMANTIC_REFERENCE' - so a repeated Semantic guess could never dedup against a prior Semantic guess. Fixed by adding DetectionCategory::Semantic with its own SQL branch, restoring the same self-dedup guarantee Paraphrase already had. This is a real, previously-undiscovered correctness fix, not merely a prerequisite for confirmation.

designDecisions.confirmNotResuggest: Dedup's existing suppression behavior (never create a second suggestion for a same-category repeat) is completely unchanged. Confirmation is strictly additive on top of it: when a repeat is suppressed, the still-pending original suggestion is looked up and its confidence bumped.
designDecisions.scopedToHeuristicKindsOnly: Direct/Chapter/Verse/Sequential citations already score 0.85-0.97 (see confidence_for_kind in core/service/src/bible_intelligence.rs) - confirming a repeated citation adds no honest signal. Only Paraphrase (raw lexical-overlap score, floor 0.75) and Semantic (raw cosine-similarity score, floor 0.55) are confirmation-eligible, since both are documented as uncalibrated single-shot heuristic guesses.
designDecisions.pendingOnly: find_pending_suggestion_for_reference filters to SuggestionStatus::Pending only - once an operator approves/edits/rejects a suggestion, a later redetection must never mutate that decision.
designDecisions.hardConfidenceCeiling: confirm_suggestion caps the boosted score at MAX_CONFIRMED_SCORE (0.9), deliberately below the ~0.97 an explicit citation earns - no amount of repetition ever lets a heuristic guess outrank a real citation. The score also never decreases (new_score = (current + bonus).min(max_score).max(current)).
designDecisions.honestConfirmationCount: confirmation_count increments unconditionally, even once the score cap is reached, so the operator can see how many times a guess was independently redetected, distinct from the (capped) confidence number itself.

policyConstants.SUGGESTION_DEDUP_WINDOW_SECONDS: 60 (unchanged, Phase 1.3) - confirmation can only ever fire within this existing window, since it piggybacks on the same has_recent_detection_for_reference check
policyConstants.CONFIRMATION_SCORE_BONUS: 0.1 - documented policy choice, not empirically calibrated, consistent with every other confidence threshold in this codebase
policyConstants.MAX_CONFIRMED_SCORE: 0.9 - the confidence ceiling for a repeatedly-confirmed heuristic suggestion

testCoverageSummary: 9 new tests in persistence.rs (Semantic dedup-category self-dedup and isolation-from-Explicit, find_pending_suggestion_for_reference's three cases - match found/non-pending ignored/no match, confirm_suggestion's increment+boost, cap-but-keep-counting, and never-decrease behavior), 2 new acceptance tests in pipeline.rs (a real repeated-paraphrase-confirms-the-original-suggestion test against the actual dev-seed BSB/KJV dataset via handle_final_transcript twice, and a control test proving a repeated explicit citation is never confirmation-boosted), 1 new test in core/ai::suggestion (confirmation_count starts at 0).
regressionResult: cargo fmt --check clean. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean under both default features and --features whisper,semantic-search. cargo test --workspace (single-threaded, routing around the pre-existing config.rs env-var test-parallelism flake documented in Phase 5.1) fully green under both feature configurations. Frontend: npm run typecheck/lint clean (no new warnings), npm run test 220/220 passing, npm run build succeeds.
